title: Update 0.4: Dodge, Qi, gear and a cracked-open Guardian
summary: Roll out of danger with Space, manage your Qi, gear up, and meet a Stone Guardian with a nasty third phase.
body:
Update 0.4 is here. The launcher will fetch it for you.

Dodge and Qi
- Press Space to roll. You cannot be hurt for a moment mid-roll, so a well-timed dodge beats any slam.
- Every skill and every dodge now spends Qi, the jade bar under your health. It refills quickly when you pause, so pick your moments.
- Enemies now warn you before they strike. Watch for red shapes on the ground and step out of them.

Gear and quests
- Equip a weapon, head, body, boots, charm and pendant. Press G to open your gear.
- Craft potions and gear with Artisan Tao, and shop with Peddler Hao in the plaza.
- Gate Warden Wu has a chain of side quests, and the Journal (J) tracks them along with merit seals and titles.
- New creatures roam the valley: Lotus Toads by the pond, packs of Stone Hounds in the north, and a rare grey fox called Old Whisker.

A prettier valley
- The day now turns to dusk and night, with fireflies, lantern light and wind in the bamboo.
- Koi swim in the pond and the shore has brush-stroke foam.
- Press N for a full map of the valley that clears as you explore.

The Stone Guardian
- When it drops low, it cracks open and glows white-hot. A beam of runes sweeps around it, so keep moving.

Options
- Press F1 for the new settings window: sound mixer, bigger text, colour-blind help and more.

Tell us what you think on the support page of the website.

title: Sword and Seal is open for testing
summary: The doors of the Realm of Mist are open. Sign in, let the launcher fetch the game, and step into Cloudmist Valley.
body:
The doors of the Realm of Mist are open. Sign in with the launcher, let it fetch the game, and step into the first valley.

What to try:
- Create a character and choose a class: Sword Cultivator, Talisman Master or Physician.
- Hunt in the bamboo groves, finish the lantern keeper's errand and face the Stone Guardian at the ruined shrine.
- Party up with other testers.

This is an early test: progress can be reset, and we want to hear what breaks. Tell us on the support page of the website.

title: Combat changes coming in 0.4
summary: Dodge rolls and a Qi pool are on the way. Every skill will cost Qi, so timing matters more than button mashing.
body:
Fights are about to get faster and fairer. Version 0.4 brings two big changes.

Dodge roll
- Press Space to roll in the direction you are moving.
- You are untouchable for a moment mid-roll, so well-timed dodges beat even the Stone Guardian's slam.

Qi
- You now have a Qi pool that refills on its own.
- Skills and dodges spend Qi. Chaining every skill without a pause will run you dry, so pick your moments.

The launcher will download 0.4 for you automatically when it is ready.

title: How to play
summary: Move with WASD, fight with keys 1 to 4, and speak to villagers with F. A quick guide for your first hour.
body:
New to the Realm of Mist? Here is everything you need for your first hour.

Controls
- W, A, S, D to move; hold the right mouse button and drag to turn the camera.
- Tab to target the nearest enemy; 1 to 4 to use your skills.
- F to speak to villagers, I for your bag, L for your quest log, B for the notice board.
- Enter to chat, F1 for in-game help.

Your first steps
- Speak to Elder Lin near the gate to start the quest chain.
- Fight Bamboo Spirits in the grove to level up, then move on to the fox spirits in the hills.
- Lantern Keeper Mei needs five Bamboo Fiber for a paper lantern.

Stuck or found a bug? Visit the support page of the website.
